neighbours.label: the word oxygen (and its pieces: oxy-, -xygen, O2)
fire: Plants release oxygen as a by-product of photosynthesis.
The patient was given extra oxygen through a mask.
Divers carry tanks of compressed oxygen and nitrogen.
Low levels of dissolved oxygen can kill fish in summer.
Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
At high altitude the air holds less oxygen per breath.
Rust forms when iron reacts with oxygen and moisture.
Hospitals stockpiled oxygen cylinders during the outbreak.
quiet: Plants release water vapor as a by-product of transpiration.
The patient was given extra fluids through a drip.
Divers carry tanks of compressed air and spare masks.
Low levels of dissolved salt can harm fish in summer.
Water is made of tiny molecules that stick together.
At high altitude the air feels colder on every breath.
Rust forms when iron reacts with water and salt.
Hospitals stockpiled masks and gloves during the outbreak.
